title: BREACH GATE NAMES THE HOLD KEY
why: His 10-28 order: hold to breach should say hold e to breach. The hold reads the search action, so the label uses its local keyboard or pad binding. Watch: the breach gate says which key to hold
now: the breach gate says which key to hold

edits.replacement:
// v28.xx (cw-cx-breachkey), his 10-28 order: "hold to breach should say hold e to breach". The search action held by shHeld is named locally in each window.
      txt=(s.prog>0)?('BREACHING  '+Math.round(s.prog*100)+'%'):('HOLD '+keyLabel('KeyE','E')+' TO BREACH');
